## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (3)
- `GET /api/common/biz/{bizToken}` — Authenticate using a business token.
- `GET /BeqYRM/dzRSF/hGlHc/MA/{MAToken}/QEQ-AQ/RANGLj/JeHScB` — Authenticate using a MAToken.
- `POST /$rpc/{$rpcToken}/GenerateIT` — Generate an IT token for authentication.

### Data Read (4)
- `GET /ko/ibe/mypage/viewReservationList.do` — Retrieve a list of user reservations.
- `GET /nac/2` — Retrieve NAC data.
- `GET /sid/json` — Retrieve SID data in JSON format.
- `POST /youtubei/v1/account/get_setting_values` — Retrieve Youtube account settings.

### Data Write (7)
- `POST /{id}` — Submit data with a specific ID.
- `POST /api/stats/{statId}` — Submit statistical data.
- `POST /campaign/` — Submit campaign data.
- `POST /data/1.11.1/jejuair` — Submit Jejuair data.
- `POST /ko/common/air/newLoading.do` — Trigger a new loading event.
- `POST /ko/ibe/booking/selectDepartureStations.json` — Select departure stations for booking.
- `POST /youtubei/v1/{v1Id}` — Submit Youtube data.

### Media (2)
- `GET /hpgg/resources/brandsite/images/{imageId}` — Retrieve an image by ID.
- `GET /hpgg/resources/brandsite/mp4/{mp4Id}` — Retrieve an MP4 video by ID.

### Realtime (2)
- `GET /sync` — Synchronize data in real-time.
- `POST /api/v3.1/apps/jejuair/events/web/{webId}` — Submit a web event for the Jejuair app.

### Config (1)
- `GET /api/config.json` — Retrieve configuration settings.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Jejuair's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Jejuair data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.jejuair.net (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Jejuair frontend uses
